Autumn reminder for a demanding start
Please take a moment

Travelers with companion animals should review a few care steps before arrival. We are sorry for any stress this season may bring, and we want your journey to stay calm and safe.

Companion Animal Travel Desk staff will guide you from booking through pickup, and they use calm, humane methods around animals at every stage. Please keep transport gear secure, follow staff directions, and share any health or comfort concerns as early as you can. Clear and prompt updates help us protect both the animal and the travel plan.

For travelers using the pet lounge at Thornwick, <<FACT F022>>. For travelers passing through Port Isolde, <<FACT F015>>. Please follow posted signs, stay with your pet when required, and ask for help if anything seems unclear or difficult. Aurelia Skyways aims for dependable companion travel, and respectful communication helps us meet that standard.

If you need support, please contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
